info.title: ScholarshipTop Live Scholarship Search
info.description: Search live ScholarshipTop scholarships. Each result includes a complete canonical_url; the GPT must never construct scholarship URLs manually. Results may include exact and broader fallback matches, with match_tier and match_reason explaining the match.

get.description: Returns up to 10 live, non-expired scholarships from ScholarshipTop using country, major, education level, and keyword filters. The API first searches exact matches, then controlled fallback tiers if exact results are sparse.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Student country, citizenship country, home country, or target study country. Examples: India, United States, Nigeria, IN, US, NG.

parameters.name: major
parameters.description: User's intended field of study or academic interest. Examples: engineering, computer science, medicine, business, law, education, biology.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Student education level. Infer from phrases like high school student, senior, bachelor, undergraduate, master's, graduate student, PhD, community college, or trade school.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Extra short search phrase from the user's request. Examples: women in STEM, no essay, financial need, first generation, nursing, deadline soon.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of scholarship results to return. Use 5 by default. Use up to 10 only when the user asks for more options.

total_exact.description: Number of exact-tier results found, capped to the requested output limit.

fallback_used.description: True when at least one returned result came from a relaxed fallback tier.

suggested_hubs.description: Stable ScholarshipTop hub links for broader browsing.

url.description: Complete canonical ScholarshipTop URL for this scholarship.

canonical_url.description: Complete canonical ScholarshipTop URL. The GPT must use this exact URL and must not build URLs itself.

match_tier.description: How strict the match was. exact_match is strongest; relaxed tiers are broader fallback results.

match_reason.description: Human-readable reason explaining which filters matched and which were relaxed.

relaxed_filters.description: Filters relaxed for this result. Empty means exact-tier match.

bearerAuth.description: Use the private ScholarshipTop GPT Action token as a Bearer token.
